plugins.cameraPermission: NexTeam uses the camera to attach field photos to assigned jobs while offline.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: NexTeam uses location to match photos to the nearest assigned client.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: NexTeam uses location while collecting Tap to Pay charges so Stripe can place the device at the correct business location.
plugins.bluetoothPeripheralPermission: NexTeam uses Bluetooth when Stripe Terminal needs to discover nearby readers.
plugins.bluetoothAlwaysUsagePermission: NexTeam uses Bluetooth to maintain Stripe Terminal reader connections during in-person collection.
plugins.localNetworkUsagePermission: NexTeam uses the local network when Stripe Terminal connects to supported readers on the same network.
